Excursions from Marrakech

Day trips with a driver-guide. We pick you up at your accommodation.

Ouzoud Falls

The most impressive waterfalls in North Africa, with a 110-metre drop split into three steps. You can cool off with a swim in its cold but clean waters and enjoy the wildlife and scenery on a walk around: there are usually monkeys.

Book

Essaouira

We travel to the Pearl of the Atlantic, visiting its medina with its ancient gates and pretty harbour. If you like fish or seafood, Essaouira is the perfect place to eat well at a very low price at any stall near the port. We also visit its long beaches of fine white sand, such as Sidi Kaouki, where you can surf and windsurf.

Book

Ouarzazate and Ait Benhaddou

In the south of Morocco, Ouarzazate is one of the gateways to the desert and a must on the way from Marrakech to the Sahara. Known as the Hollywood of Morocco for its film studios, where Cleopatra and Asterix were shot. We visit the Taourirt kasbah, one of the best preserved, and the most famous of all, Ait Benhaddou, 30 km away, a World Heritage Site and the setting of Gladiator and Lawrence of Arabia.

Book

Ourika Valley

We travel through the High Atlas, seeing the way of life of its people and its splendid landscapes. We follow the Ourika river into the valley up to its waterfalls; the bravest can take a dip, although the water is freezing. For the adventurous we do some trekking. Depending on the day of the week we may visit one of the traditional markets.
